cards.title: Same-n hydrogen position matrix

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 1 Stark Hamiltonian and standard hydrogen parabolic-state algebra

checks.reason: The paper states that the Stark Hamiltonian is diagonalized in the hydrogenic basis.
For n=20 and 24 the matrix eigenvalues equal the exact parabolic values 3nk/2 to below 1e-12 a0.

cards.numerical_form: Construct the real symmetric tridiagonal matrix at fixed n and m_l.

cards.title: Linear hydrogen Stark energy

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 1 and cited Stark-state method

cards.latex: Delta E^(1)_(nkm) = (3/2) n k e a0 F

checks.reason: The paper and its cited Stark-state method use the standard first-order hydrogen Stark energy.
Diagonalizing EQ001 yields the complete allowed k sequence at fixed m.
The k=0 first-order shift vanishes.

cards.numerical_form: Use the exact eigenvalue sequence to cross-check the numerical diagonalization.

cards.title: Leading reduced-mass Dirac correction

source_refs.value: Supplemental field-free corrections described in the main text; standard hydrogen Dirac expansion

checks.reason: The main text identifies field-free relativistic/QED corrections and the implemented leading term is the standard Dirac expansion.
R_H c supplies frequency and the remaining factors are dimensionless.
The correction decays as n^-3 and becomes smaller for high-l states.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the diagonal l,j correction and Clebsch-weight it in a fixed m_l,m_s basis.
open_questions: Higher-order QED, finite-size, and exact supplemental hyperfine entries are not recovered from this leading model.

cards.title: Second-order inter-manifold Stark correction

source_refs.value: Standard hydrogen Stark expansion used for the supplemental 0.4 and 0.8 V/cm table

checks.reason: The cited Stark treatment includes coupling to neighboring n manifolds; this is the standard closed second-order hydrogen expression.
The correction vanishes at zero field.
Doubling the field from 0.4 to 0.8 V/cm increases the correction exactly fourfold.

cards.numerical_form: Convert F to atomic units and the energy to Hz with E_h/h.

cards.title: Declared high-n hyperfine branch estimate

source_refs.value: Ground-state HFS scaled as 6/n^5 to resolve the five printed high-n branches

checks.reason: The paper resolves five high-n hyperfine-Stark branches; the n^-5 rule is explicitly declared as the local reconstruction assumption.
The approximation is isolated to close-branch resolution and never used to infer the gross Stark scale.
Across 20 printed table entries the full model differs by at most 2.16 kHz.

cards.numerical_form: Apply fixed rational branch factors after the independently generated Dirac-plus-Stark energy.
open_questions: Exact branch-resolved hyperfine coefficients require the inaccessible formal supplement.

cards.title: Asymmetric double-Doppler line component
cards.latex: S_i(nu) = A_i exp[-(nu-nu_i)^2/(2 sigma_i^2)] {1+erf[s_i gamma(nu-nu_i)/(sqrt(2) sigma_i)]}

checks.reason: The cited method paper prints the Gaussian-error-function line model.
At gamma=0 each component becomes Gaussian; the code generates exactly six components for k=-2,0,+2 and two Doppler directions.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate six components on a 2001-point detuning grid and normalize only the total amplitude.
open_questions: The measured black spectrum and exact fitted covariance are not deposited.

cards.title: Appendix Stark and Doppler regressions
cards.latex: Delta nu_F = b F^2; Delta nu_D = a nu_D

checks.reason: The paper prints b=-0.3(3.5) kHz/(V/cm)^2 and a=-0.9(1.8) kHz/MHz.
The endpoint uncertainty bands are propagated directly from the printed slope errors.

cards.numerical_form: Generate the theoretical trend and one-sigma band without fabricating measurement points.
open_questions: Point-level field and Doppler scans are unavailable.

cards.title: Independent uncertainty quadrature

checks.reason: Main Table I prints each correction and statistical/systematic uncertainty component.
Printed rows give 2.884 kHz statistical and 1.241 kHz systematic quadrature.
The code exposes positive residual components needed to reach the reported 3.7 and 1.8 kHz totals rather than silently forcing closure.

cards.numerical_form: Keep printed rows and report residual unlisted components separately.
open_questions: The main table does not itemize every contribution to the final totals.

cards.title: Ground-state binding-frequency assembly

checks.reason: The main text prints the three-frequency assembly and final 1S binding frequency.
Forty-digit decimal arithmetic avoids float loss at the 3.3e15-Hz scale.
Rounded printed inputs differ from the printed final value by 52.23 Hz, compatible with hidden guard digits.

cards.numerical_form: Add the three printed decimal frequencies without binary floating-point conversion.
open_questions: Unrounded internal experimental values are unavailable, so the 52.23-Hz difference is inconclusive rather than a paper error.
